name: telegram
description: Send messages and files via Telegram Bot API

telegram.setup.title: Setup Guide
telegram.setup.description:
1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
2. Send /newbot and follow the prompts to create a bot
3. Copy the Bot Token and paste it below
4. Open your new bot in Telegram and send /start
5. Click "Fetch Chat ID" to auto-detect your chat
6. Click "Send Test Message" to verify the connection

telegram.setupMultiFolder.title: Connecting Multiple Folders (Optional)
telegram.setupMultiFolder.description:
If you only connect one Filer folder to Telegram, skip this — the setup above is enough.

To connect more than one folder, each one needs its own conversation thread, which Telegram provides via Topics inside a group (not a 1:1 bot chat):
1. Create a new Telegram group and add your bot to it.
2. Open the group's settings and turn on "Topics".
3. In the group's Administrators settings, promote your bot to admin and make sure "Manage Topics" is enabled for it — Filer needs this to create a topic per folder.
4. Send any message in the group (so Telegram registers it), then click "Fetch Chat ID" above again — it should now find the group instead of your personal chat. A group's Chat ID is a negative number; if you see a positive number, "Fetch Chat ID" is still pointed at your personal DM with the bot.
5. Connect each folder you want to Telegram — Filer creates a matching topic automatically the first time that folder sends a message.
